Mattel Intellivision for Analogue Pocket
A clean-room core, written from Mattel's and General Instrument's
documents, with save states designed in. Work in progress: this build
runs the EXEC and cartridges and shows their background picture (cards,
Color Stack, Colored Squares, Foreground/Background); no moving objects,
no sound and no controls yet.

System ROMs (yours to supply, in /Assets/intv/common/):
  exec.bin     EXEC ROM, 8,192 bytes (required)
  grom.bin     GROM, 2,048 bytes (required)
  ecs.bin      ECS ROM, 24,576 bytes (optional, for ECS games)
  ivoice.bin   Intellivoice SP0256-012 ROM, 2,048 bytes (optional)

Cartridges: .int / .bin / .rom / .itv, with an optional .cfg.

While the files load, or when a required one is missing, a test pattern
shows instead. Its bottom row has one block per file: cartridge, config,
EXEC, GROM, ECS, Intellivoice. Green = loaded, right size; yellow =
loaded, other size; red = required and missing; grey = optional and
missing.

Licenses: see the licenses/ folder (MIT, with third-party notices).
